summary.one_liner: Whale is an unofficial desktop app for Trello, distributed for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and describes Whale as an unofficial Trello app. It gives install steps for macOS, Windows, and Linux, each based on downloading and extracting a .zip archive. On macOS it can also be installed through Homebrew as a cask. The README does not describe features, configuration, or how the app is built. It names only the MIT license and the author, Shogo Sensui.
use_cases: Use Trello from a desktop app
Install a Trello client on macOS via Homebrew
Run a Trello wrapper on Windows or Linux
Manage Trello boards outside the browser
how_to_run: Download and extract the .zip for your platform, then move Whale.app to /Applications (macOS)
Download and extract the .zip, then move Whale.exe to a location of your choice (Windows)
Download and extract the .zip, then move Whale to a location of your choice (Linux)
notable: Unofficial third-party Trello client, not affiliated with Trello
Prebuilt downloads for macOS, Windows, and Linux
Homebrew cask available for macOS installs
caveats: Requires macOS 12 (Monterey) or later on macOS
README gives no feature list, usage guide, or build instructions
Unofficial app, so it is not maintained or endorsed by Trello
